$meta.name: signed-installer-spawns-shell
$meta.description: The application under test is a signed setup program the user downloaded. Installers run command interpreters by design, which is what P-002's own description exempts, and the exemption needs the signature as well as the name: here it has both. P-004 stays quiet too, because Argus launched this binary itself — its download location is the operator's choice, not behaviour of the session.
